# Blocklane Storage — Self Storage Website Prompt
## 1. Goal Statement
Build a utilitarian, conversion-focused self storage website for **Blocklane Storage**, defined by concrete grey, steel white, and a single high-visibility orange — where the entire page exists to answer one question: which unit size do I need and what does it cost.
## 2. Tech Stack
React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (motion/react) + shadcn/ui + lucide-react
## 3. Design System — Colors
:root { --background: hsl(210, 16%, 97%); --foreground: hsl(214, 22%, 15%); --primary: hsl(24, 94%, 52%); }
## 9. Full Copy
BLOCKLANE STORAGE · Leeds · Navbar: Sizes & Prices · What You Get · Business · Supplies · Find Us · 0113 555 0155 · Reserve a Unit
Hero: PICK A SIZE. MOVE IN TODAY.
Size selector: 25 sq ft £22/week · 50 sq ft £38/week · 100 sq ft £62/week · 200 sq ft £108/week
All sizes table with 8 unit sizes from 10 sq ft (£12/wk) to 200 sq ft (£108/wk)
What you get: 24/7 gate access · Individually alarmed units · CCTV · Drive-up loading · Free trolleys · No deposit
How it works: Pick a size → Reserve online → Sign and pay → Move in same day
